externalNote: Every file this repository reads and may not ship, or fetches rather than carries. Each lives under external/, which git and Dropbox both ignore. python3 -m conformance.external reports which are here, which are missing and which are not the file named; SHA-256 alone decides a file, and HEAD decides a checkout.

master-everdrive-5-tools-service-test-ca.purpose: The Master EverDrive pack's test cartridges, among them both ZEXALL builds and the SMS Test Suite this member runs.

canonical_form.notes: The archive itself, because the runners read it as it is; conformance/testroms.json names each cartridge inside by its own SHA-256.

accepted.label: 5 Tools & Service Test Carts
